```{=html}
<div class="steps-list">

 <article class="step-card" id="step-1">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/red-braised-chicken-wings/images/prep.png" alt="准备食材"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">01</span>
    <span class="step-title">准备食材</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>5 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>鸡翅清洗干净，用刀在两面各划两道口子（深约半厘米），方便入味。</li>
    <li>姜切片，葱白和葱绿分开切，葱白切段，葱绿切花备用。</li>
    <li>蒜瓣拍裂去皮。八角、香叶备好放在一起。</li>
   </ol>
   <div class="step-tip"><i data-lucide="lightbulb"></i><span>鸡翅的鸡皮致密，不划口子的话酱汁只会停在表面。划两道就能让味道渗到肉里。</span></div>
  </div>
 </article>

 <article class="step-card" id="step-2">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/red-braised-chicken-wings/images/blanching.png" alt="焯水鸡翅"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">02</span>
    <span class="step-title">焯水鸡翅</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>5 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>鸡翅冷水下锅，加 2 片姜和 1 汤匙料酒。</li>
    <li>中火加热到沸腾，表面会浮起一层灰褐色的浮沫。</li>
    <li>用勺子撇干净浮沫，再煮 30 秒。捞出鸡翅用温水冲洗，沥干备用。</li>
   </ol>
   <div class="step-warn"><i data-lucide="triangle-alert"></i><span>必须冷水下锅。热水下锅会让肉表面立刻收紧，血水和腥味反而留在里面。</span></div>
  </div>
 </article>

 <article class="step-card" id="step-3">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/red-braised-chicken-wings/images/caramel-sugar.png" alt="炒糖色"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">03</span>
    <span class="step-title">炒糖色</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>3 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>锅中倒 1 汤匙食用油，小火加热，下入 25 克冰糖。</li>
    <li>用铲子不停地划动，让冰糖慢慢融化。</li>
    <li>糖液会经历：透明 → 浅黄 → 金黄 → 深琥珀色冒小泡。看到颜色变成枣红色、表面起细密小泡时，立刻进入下一步。</li>
   </ol>
   <div class="step-warn"><i data-lucide="triangle-alert"></i><span>炒糖色全程小火，眼睛不要离开锅。最后几秒颜色变得很快，一愣神就糊了发苦。如果觉得这步太难，可以直接跳过，第 5 步多加半茶匙老抽补色，味道也很好。</span></div>
  </div>
 </article>

 <article class="step-card" id="step-4">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/red-braised-chicken-wings/images/searing.png" alt="爆香煸炒"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">04</span>
    <span class="step-title">爆香煸炒</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>4 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>糖色一变深，立刻下姜片、葱白段、蒜瓣，转中火翻炒 10 秒。</li>
    <li>下八角和香叶，再炒 10 秒。</li>
    <li>沥干的鸡翅下锅，转中大火不停翻动，让每只鸡翅都裹上糖色和香料。</li>
    <li>炒到鸡皮表面均匀上色、稍微紧致即可。</li>
   </ol>
   <div class="step-tip"><i data-lucide="lightbulb"></i><span>糖色到位后香料下锅的时机很关键，糖色再煮十几秒就会过焦。先把姜葱蒜和香料备好放在锅边伸手就能拿到。</span></div>
  </div>
 </article>

 <article class="step-card" id="step-5">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/red-braised-chicken-wings/images/braising.png" alt="加水焖煮"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">05</span>
    <span class="step-title">加水焖煮</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>20 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>沿锅边淋 1 汤匙料酒，激发香气。</li>
    <li>倒入热水，水量没过鸡翅一半即可（鸡翅不需要全淹，因为最后要收汁）。</li>
    <li>加入 2 汤匙生抽、半汤匙老抽、半茶匙盐。</li>
    <li>大火烧开后转小火，盖上锅盖焖煮 15–18 分钟。</li>
   </ol>
   <div class="step-tip"><i data-lucide="lightbulb"></i><span>水量是 红烧 和 卤 的关键区别——红烧水少，最后要把汤汁收成浓稠的酱汁挂在鸡翅上。</span></div>
  </div>
 </article>

 <article class="step-card" id="step-6">
  <div class="step-photo"><img src="/recipes/red-braised-chicken-wings/images/plating.png" alt="收汁出锅"></div>
  <div class="step-body">
   <div class="step-head">
    <span class="step-num">06</span>
    <span class="step-title">收汁出锅</span>
    <span class="step-time"><i data-lucide="clock"></i>5 分</span>
   </div>
   <ol class="step-list">
    <li>开盖转大火，让汤汁咕嘟咕嘟地翻滚。</li>
    <li>不停地用勺子把汤汁淋在鸡翅上，2–3 分钟后汤汁就会变得浓稠、油亮发光。</li>
    <li>关火，夹出鸡翅装盘，淋上锅中剩下的酱汁，撒上葱花点缀。</li>
   </ol>
   <div class="step-warn"><i data-lucide="triangle-alert"></i><span>收汁时千万不要离开锅。汤汁从"有点稠"到"焦底"只差几十秒，糊了整道菜就毁了。</span></div>
  </div>
 </article>

</div>
```
